status: current recommended defaults; review when provider docs or repo evals change

supervisor.escalation_trigger: Gates conflict, branch risk changes, or merge decision is unclear.
supervisor.output_contract: Cycle report and final merge recommendation.
supervisor.tool_permission_posture: Orchestrates subagents and makes limited direct edits.

planner.escalation_trigger: Roadmap ambiguity or branch decomposition risk.
planner.output_contract: Ready batch with dependencies and stop rules.

architecture_specialist.escalation_trigger: Active firmware, runtime model, or source authority is involved.
architecture_specialist.output_contract: Architecture note with evidence and unknowns.

implementer.escalation_trigger: Edits cross ownership boundaries or firmware source.

validator_reviewer.openai_codex_default: GPT-5.5 for firmware risk; GPT-5.4 mini for docs/checker-only
validator_reviewer.openai_reasoning_effort: medium/high for firmware risk; medium for docs/checker-only
validator_reviewer.claude_default: Sonnet 5 or Opus 4.8 depending firmware risk
validator_reviewer.escalation_trigger: Active behavior, generated artifacts, or merge gate is involved.

docs_status_clerk.output_contract: Status doc delta and consistency checks.

judge_watchdog.escalation_trigger: Loop, unsafe path, or hardware gate appears.
judge_watchdog.de_escalation_trigger: Branch is clearly done or blocked.
